item.title: Building OINK
item.description:
Two pieces published the same day, meant to be read in order. The first says what OINK is and what it deliberately refuses to do; the second is the engineering record underneath that claim — the migrations, the safety boundaries, the tests, and the arguments that did not survive contact with eleven production sites.

Read the announcement for the shape of the thing, the diary for why it has that shape.

item.title: OINK releases
item.description: This series is the ordered release history of OINK. Each note records what changed, how to migrate, and which verification evidence belongs to that version.
